items.headline: Public meeting on Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review
items.summary: Sunnyvale held a public scoping meeting for the environmental impact report on the proposed 1250 Oakmead Parkway residential project, giving residents a chance to weigh in on what the review should study.

items.headline: Six new single-family homes permitted on Adeline Avenue
items.summary: Building permits were issued for six new homes at 802, 806, 810, 814, 818, and 822 Adeline Avenue, part of a 'Phase 3.1 Comm Hill' development with individual valuations ranging from about $474,000 to $512,000 per unit.
